title: Edit plan
description: The interface between bot/ (produces) and render/ (consumes). A plan is one source file, one output spec, and an ordered list of clips. Each clip is a keep-list of time segments from the source, concatenated in order. v1.1 adds an optional reel; v1.2 adds music, transitions, opening and closing cards; v1.3 adds transitions drawn by a Python module; v1.4 adds image and QR-code cards, several cards before a clip, text overlays on a clip and a picture-in-picture layout for shared screens: the renderer also concatenates every clip, with optional slide cards, into one summary video. Nothing else is implied: no effects, no transitions, no re-encoding choices beyond what output.* states.

version.description: Contract version. Renderer must reject any other value. v1.1 fields are all optional, so v1 plans stay valid.

path.description: Path to the source video, relative to the repo root or absolute. Forward slashes only; the renderer normalizes for the OS.

duration_seconds.description: Optional. If present the renderer must reject any segment whose end exceeds it.

kind.description: Where captions come from. embedded = subtitle stream in the source (e.g. Meet mov_text). srt = sidecar file at `path`. none = no captions available.

dir.description: Directory the renderer writes into. Created if missing. Files are named <clip.id>.<container>.

preset.description: Destination preset. Sets defaults for aspect and encoding; explicit fields on output override the preset. See bot/research/clip-guidelines.md.

aspect.description: Output frame. 16:9 keeps the source frame. 9:16 and 1:1 center-crop unless a clip sets crop_focus.

captions.description: burn_in renders captions into the pixels. sidecar_srt writes <clip.id>.srt next to the video. Ignored when source.captions.kind = none.

reel.description: v1.1/v1.2. When present, the renderer ALSO writes one concatenated summary video: [intro] + [opening cards] + for each clip in order ([card] + clip) + [closing cards] + [outro]. Every segment is normalized to one size, frame rate and audio layout; cards carry silence (or the music bed) so audio is continuous. Individual clip files are still written exactly as in v1.

intro.description: Optional slide before the first clip.

outro.description: Optional slide after the last clip.

chapter_cards.description: auto = a card before a clip only when that clip carries its own `card`. all = every clip gets a card, synthesized from clip.takeaway when it has none. none = never.

opening.description: v1.2. Cards shown after the intro and before the first clip, e.g. 'What you'll learn'.

closing.description: v1.2. Cards shown after the last clip and before the outro: the takeaways / summary at the end.

music.description: v1.2. A music bed. Plays under the intro, opening, chapter, closing and outro cards (under: cards), or under everything ducked below speech (under: all). Faded in/out at the edges of each card run. The file must be public domain or otherwise licensed for the project; see assets/music/LICENSE.

gain_db.description: Level of the bed relative to full scale when it is the only sound (under cards).

duck_db.description: Level of the bed under speech (only used with under: all).

loop.description: Loop the file if it is shorter than what it has to cover.

transition.description: v1.2. How one segment joins the next. cut = hard cut (v1.1 behaviour). dip = fade to black and back. dissolve = crossfade. module (v1.3) = a dissolve whose picture is drawn by the Python file named in `module`. Applied at every join between cards and clips.

module.description: v1.3. Repo-root-relative or absolute path to a Python file exposing render(a, b, t, state): a and b are HxWx3 uint8 RGB numpy arrays (outgoing and incoming frame at the same instant), t runs 0.0 to 1.0 over the transition, state is a dict that lives for one join; returns an HxWx3 uint8 RGB array. Required exactly when kind is module. The plan's `seconds` decides the length; a SECONDS constant in the file is advisory.

audio_fade_seconds.description: v1.2. Fade the clip audio in and out at every cut so speech never starts or stops abruptly.

summary.description: Optional companion document (executive summary + transcript). Produced by bot/, written here so render/ can copy it into output.dir. See veb-t2b.6.

end.description: Seconds from source start, exclusive. Must be > start.

card.description: v1.1. A full-frame slide: dark background, a title, up to four lines of text, shown for `seconds` with silent audio. The renderer draws it. v1.4: a card may also show one picture beside the text: `image` (a PNG or JPEG file, e.g. a screenshot) or `qr` (a URL the renderer draws as a QR code with the URL under it), never both.

image.description: v1.4. Repo-root-relative or absolute path to a PNG or JPEG shown beside the text (16:9: text left, picture right; 9:16 and 1:1: picture below the text), scaled to fit and never cropped.

qr.description: v1.4. A URL the renderer draws as a scannable QR code, with the URL printed under it so it can also be typed. Placed like `image`.

id.description: Output file stem. Unique within the plan.

takeaway.description: One sentence: the single idea this clip lands. Used for the title card / filename metadata / summary.

segments.description: Keep-list. Rendered in array order and concatenated. Segments may be non-contiguous and out of source order. Total kept duration should stay within the preset's length bounds; the renderer warns but does not reject.

hook_offset_seconds.description: Offset within the concatenated clip where the payoff sentence starts. Informational for the renderer (title-card timing); the bot should already have ordered segments so this is 0.

trim_silence.description: Renderer may tighten leading/trailing silence at segment boundaries by up to 0.5 s. Never removes speech.

crop_focus.description: Only used when output.aspect is not 16:9. speaker = renderer's best effort; falls back to center.

card.description: v1.1. Optional explainer slide shown immediately before this clip in the reel (only used when output.reel is present).

cards.description: v1.4. Slides shown in order immediately before this clip in the reel (before `card` when both are set): a section opener, a 'what this covers' slide, a QR card for a link mentioned in the clip. Only used when output.reel is present.

layout.description: v1.4. How the source picture is framed. full (default) = the source frame as is. pip = picture-in-picture for a recorded screen share: the `screen` region fills the frame as large as it fits, and the `speaker` region (the call's active-speaker tile) is shown small in `corner`, beside the screen when the frame has room and over it otherwise. Only used for 16:9 output; other aspects ignore it with a warning.

screen.description: pip: the shared-screen region, [x, y, w, h] in source pixels.

speaker.description: pip: the speaker tile region, [x, y, w, h] in source pixels. Optional: without it the screen alone fills the frame.

overlays.description: v1.4. Short text shown over the clip while the source time is in [start, end) and that time is kept by a segment: a label that says what the screen shows. Times are source seconds, like segments, so trimming never moves a label onto the wrong picture. Burned like captions; `top` keeps it clear of them.
